content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-61. - Prohibitions—General.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to make, continue, or cause to be made or continued
               any excessive or unusually loud noise, or to create a noise disturbance within the
               limits of the city.
(Code 1981, § 19-11; Ord. No. 2208, § 1, 9-16-1985)
